highlights.title: Google Open Sources Ambient Quality Agent (AQuA) to Diagnose Production AI Agent Failures
highlights.contentSnippet: Google has open-sourced AQuA, a reference implementation that analyzes production AI agent sessions, verifies recurring failure patterns, and investigates root causes against deployed source snapshots. In a 32-session replay, developers reduced seat selection bypasses from 15 sessions to two and dietary preference omissions from seven to zero after prompt changes. By Leela Kumili

highlights.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
highlights.contentSnippet: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

highlights.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
highlights.contentSnippet: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

highlights.title: Uber's Secure AI Framework Governs Autonomous AI Agents across Their Lifecycle
highlights.contentSnippet: In a recent article, Uber Engineering highlights the limitations of traditional identity and API controls in securing AI agents that dynamically reason over external content and take real-world actions. Uber developed a framework to determine whether an agent's action is appropriate given the user's request, the agent's intended purpose, its permissions, and the context of the interaction. By Sergio De Simone

highlights.title: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
highlights.contentSnippet: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. It is in enterprise research preview, with no published benchmarks, size or pricing yet. The post Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls appeared first on MarkTechPost.

highlights.title: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
highlights.contentSnippet: Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. The post Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

rankedItems.title: Anthropic Outlines its AI-Powered Code Review Process for Claude Code
rankedItems.contentSnippet: Anthropic has outlined how the Claude Code team handles code reviews as AI agents increasingly contribute to its codebase. rankedItems.title: Cohere Finding Shows Self-Hosted Open-Weight Models Still Need Egress Controls
rankedItems.contentSnippet: Cohere recently reported that one of Alibaba’s newest Qwen3.8 models attempted to upload a probe file to a storage container in Beijing while explicitly stating in its reasoning trace that no tools would be triggered. While there is no evidence of intentional backdooring, the report is a reminder that, even for self-hosted agents based on open-weight models, egress risks exist and need mitigation. By Bruno Couriol

rankedItems.title: Netflix Turns Operational Data into a Knowledge Graph for AI-Driven Observability
rankedItems.contentSnippet: Netflix is developing an ontology-driven knowledge graph to accelerate production investigations and provide AI agents with a shared understanding of its operational environment. By Craig Risi

rankedItems.title: Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy
rankedItems.contentSnippet: Cmpnd released dspy-wsp, a prototype DSPy optimizer for weight-space programming. A frontier LLM reads a small model’s weights, edits them in a sandbox, and tests each change, with no gradients and about $5 to $10 per run. The post Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy appeared first on MarkTechPost.

rankedItems.title: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
rankedItems.contentSnippet: Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. It reaches 84.33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context. The post Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

rankedItems.title: Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate
rankedItems.contentSnippet: Perplexity Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 are open-weight decision models that return probabilities, not text. Version 1.3 adds Locate for span extraction and reports 91.6% mean accuracy on 63 query-classification tasks. The post Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate appeared first on MarkTechPost.

highlights.title: Google Open Sources Ambient Quality Agent (AQuA) to Diagnose Production AI Agent Failures
highlights.contentSnippet: Google has open-sourced AQuA, a reference implementation that analyzes production AI agent sessions, verifies recurring failure patterns, and investigates root causes against deployed source snapshots. In a 32-session replay, developers reduced seat selection bypasses from 15 sessions to two and dietary preference omissions from seven to zero after prompt changes. By Leela Kumili

highlights.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
highlights.contentSnippet: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

highlights.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
highlights.contentSnippet: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

highlights.title: Uber's Secure AI Framework Governs Autonomous AI Agents across Their Lifecycle
highlights.contentSnippet: In a recent article, Uber Engineering highlights the limitations of traditional identity and API controls in securing AI agents that dynamically reason over external content and take real-world actions. Uber developed a framework to determine whether an agent's action is appropriate given the user's request, the agent's intended purpose, its permissions, and the context of the interaction. By Sergio De Simone

highlights.title: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
highlights.contentSnippet: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. It is in enterprise research preview, with no published benchmarks, size or pricing yet. The post Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls appeared first on MarkTechPost.

highlights.title: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
highlights.contentSnippet: Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. The post Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

highlights.title: Open Source DocumentDB 1.0 Reaches General Availability
highlights.contentSnippet: DocumentDB 1.0 is the first generally available release of the open source, MIT-licensed document database built on PostgreSQL, with compatibility for the MongoDB wire protocol. Most MongoDB drivers, tools, and queries work without changes. By Renato Losio
